title: Agentic AI for Scalable and Robust Optical Systems Control
abstract: arXiv:2602.20144v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present AgentOptics, an agentic AI framework for high-fidelity, autonomous optical system control built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). AgentOptics interprets natural language tasks and executes protocol-compliant actions on heterogeneous optical devices through a structured tool abstraction layer. We implement 64 standardized MCP tools across 8 representative optical devices and construct a 410-task benchmark to evaluate request understanding, role-aware responses, multi-step coordination, robustness to linguistic variation, and error handling. We assess two deployment configurations--commercial online LLMs and locally hosted open-source LLMs--and compare them with LLM-based code generation baselines. AgentOptics achieves 87.7%--99.0% average task success rates, significantly outperforming code-generation approaches, which reach up to 50% success. translated_title: 面向可扩展且稳健光学系统控制的智能体AI
translated_abstract: 我们提出了AgentOptics，一个基于模型上下文协议构建的高保真、自主光学系统控制智能体AI框架。AgentOptics能够理解自然语言任务，并通过结构化的工具抽象层在异构光学设备上执行符合协议的操作。我们在8种代表性光学设备上实现了64个标准化MCP工具，并构建了一个包含410个任务的基准测试，用于评估请求理解、角色感知响应、多步骤协调、对语言变化的鲁棒性以及错误处理能力。我们评估了两种部署配置——商用在线大语言模型和本地托管的开源大语言模型——并将它们与基于大语言模型的代码生成基线进行了比较。AgentOptics实现了87.7%至99.0%的平均任务成功率，显著优于代码生成方法（后者最高仅达到50%的成功率）。我们进一步通过五个案例研究展示了该框架更广泛的适用性。
tldr: AgentOptics是一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的智能体AI框架，通过自然语言理解和标准化工具抽象层实现对异构光学设备的自主控制，平均任务成功率达87.7%–99.0%，显著超越代码生成基线方法。
